ls /opt/redis-7.2/bin; which redis-server redis-cli; redis-cli -p 6380 info server | head -20; redis-cli -p 6379 info keyspace; redis-cli -p 6380 info keyspace; redis-cli -p 6379 info replication; redis-cli -p 6380 info replication; grep -vE '^\s*(#|$)' /etc/redis-old/redis.conf /etc/redis/redis.conf

redis-cli -p 6379 module list; redis-cli -p 6379 info server | grep version; redis-cli -p 6379 config get databases; redis-cli -p 6380 config get databases; redis-cli -p 6380 config get maxmemory*; redis-cli -p 6379 info memory | grep used_memory_human; redis-cli -p 6379 info persistence | grep -E 'rdb_|aof_enabled'

redis-cli -p 6379 info replication | grep offset; sleep 2; redis-cli -p 6379 info replication | grep master_repl_offset; redis-cli -p 6380 info keyspace; python3 -c "import redis; print(redis.__version__)"; redis-cli -p 6379 info commandstats | head

redis-cli -p 6380 replicaof no one; redis-cli -p 6380 info replication | head -3; redis-cli -p 6380 config get replica-read-only; redis-cli -p 6380 set __migtest 1 && redis-cli -p 6380 del __migtest; redis-cli -p 6379 info replication | grep connected_slaves

cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
s=open('cmp.py').read()
s=s.replace("a=redis.Redis(port=6379,db=db); b=redis.Redis(port=6380,db=db)","a=redis.Redis(port=6379,db=db,decode_responses=True,encoding_errors='surrogateescape'); b=redis.Redis(port=6380,db=db,decode_responses=True,encoding_errors='surrogateescape')")
s=s.replace("t=t.decode()","")
s=re.sub(r"            # idle.*?va,vb=strip\(va\),strip\(vb\)\n", """            def strip(v):
                if isinstance(v,dict): return {x:strip(y) for x,y in v.items() if x not in ('idle','inactive','time_since_delivered')}
                if isinstance(v,(list,tuple)): return [strip(x) for x in v]
                return v
            va,vb=strip(va),strip(vb)
""", s, flags=re.S)
open('cmp.py','w').write(s)
EOF
python3 /tmp/cmp.py 2>&1 | tail -20
